title: pleroma alatum
intro: Pleroma alatum, commonly known as the "sensitive plant" or "touch-me-not," is a plant species in the pea family Fabaceae. This plant is known for its compound leaves that fold up when touched, which has led to its association with sensitivity. Pleroma alatum has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Pleroma alatum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing.
